Print options

Source: R/numpy_misc.R
jnp_printoptions.Rd

Ports of jnp.get_printoptions, jnp.set_printoptions and jnp.printoptions (NumPy's print options, which JAX uses to print arrays). The options are stored per session with NumPy's defaults; jnp_printoptions sets them while code runs.

Usage

jnp_get_printoptions()

jnp_set_printoptions(
  precision = NULL,
  threshold = NULL,
  edgeitems = NULL,
  linewidth = NULL,
  suppress = NULL,
  nanstr = NULL,
  infstr = NULL,
  formatter = NULL,
  sign = NULL,
  floatmode = NULL,
  legacy = NULL,
  override_repr = NULL
)

jnp_printoptions(code, ...)

Arguments

precision, threshold, edgeitems, linewidth, suppress, nanstr, infstr, formatter, sign, floatmode, legacy, override_repr

NumPy print options; NULL leaves an option unchanged.

code

Code to evaluate with the options set.

...

Options for jnp_printoptions, as for jnp_set_printoptions.

Value

jnp_get_printoptions returns the list of options; jnp_set_printoptions returns the previous options invisibly; jnp_printoptions returns the value of code.
